On the left side there is a horizontal rope, labeled with tension T = 10 N, and its direction is pulling the knot to the left. Below the knot there is a vertical rope connected to a suspended weight, and the weight is labeled W = ?. At the upper right of the knot there is an inclined rope connected to the ceiling, and the angle between the inclined rope and the horizontal ceiling is marked in the figure as 60°. Reasoning: Let the tension in the inclined rope be S. The system is at rest, so the forces on the knot are balanced. In the horizontal direction, the horizontal component of the inclined rope is to the right, with magnitude S cos 60°, and it balances the 10 N tension of the left horizontal rope, therefore S cos 60° = 10 N. In the vertical direction, the vertical component of the inclined rope is upward, with magnitude S sin 60°, and it balances the downward pulling force W on the knot from the lower weight through the vertical rope, therefore W = S sin 60°. From S cos 60° = 10, obtain S = 10 / cos 60° = 20 N, so W = 20 sin 60° = 20 · (√3/2) = 10√3 N. Final answer: 10√3 N

raw_record.question_text: A mass with unknown weight \( W \) is suspended from cords as shown above. When the system is in static equilibrium, the tension in the horizontal cord is 10 N. What is the weight \( W \) of the mass?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a three-cord junction: a horizontal cord pulls left with tension 10 N, a vertical cord pulls downward on the junction and supports the mass of weight W, and a slanted cord pulls up-right making 60° with the horizontal ceiling. Let the slanted-cord tension be S. Apply static equilibrium at the junction. Horizontal balance gives S cos 60° = 10 N. Vertical balance gives W = S sin 60°. Eliminate S to get W = 10 tan 60° = 10√3 N.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一个三绳结点。左侧是一根水平绳，标注张力 T = 10 N，方向对结点为向左拉。结点下方有一根竖直绳连接悬挂的重物，重物标为 W = ?。结点右上方有一根斜绳连接到天花板，图中标出斜绳与水平天花板之间的角为 60°。

推理：设斜绳张力为 S。系统静止，所以结点受力平衡。水平方向上，斜绳的水平分量向右，大小为 S cos 60°，它平衡左侧水平绳的 10 N 张力，因此 S cos 60° = 10 N。竖直方向上，斜绳的竖直分量向上，大小为 S sin 60°，它平衡下方重物通过竖直绳对结点的向下拉力 W，因此 W = S sin 60°。由 S cos 60° = 10 得 S = 10 / cos 60° = 20 N，所以 W = 20 sin 60° = 20 · (√3/2) = 10√3 N。

最终答案：10√3 N

method.method_draft: Use a force-triangle construction for the knot. From the image, the knot is acted on by exactly three forces: 10 N horizontally left, W vertically downward, and the slanted tension up-right along a cord that is 60° above the horizontal. Since the knot is in equilibrium, these three vectors must form a closed triangle. The horizontal and vertical forces are perpendicular legs of a right triangle, and the resultant of the 10 N leftward force and W downward force must be opposite the slanted cord direction. Because the slanted cord makes 60° with the horizontal, the force triangle has tan 60° = W/10. Therefore W = 10 tan 60° = 10√3 N.
